rule.proposal: Existing M8B score>=0.1 one-to-one projection association, unchanged
rule.IdentitySupported: GT unique render association purity>=0.9 plus >=8 retained maskpixels; projected rectangle vs tight instancebbox IoU>=0.5 and maskrecall>=0.8, competitor identity bbox IoU<0.1 in each supporting view. At least2 agreeing views AND no contradictory view. Automated evidence-supported, not human certified. No 3Derror used.
rule.ProjectionProxyOnly: Original projection pair without sufficient multi-view identity evidence
rule.AmbiguousAssociation: Competitor identity support in same view, or inconsistent identity across views
rule.NoSupportedAssociation: No original one-to-one pair at declared score

limits: IdentitySupported is automated multiview mask/bbox evidence, not certifiedhuman annotation or object mesh identity
Conditional proxy preserved via immutable M8B ledger; no new GT errors assigned to ambiguous/untrusted candidates
Calibration and historicalsealed only fixed-rule descriptive audit; no selection or threshold fitting
NoSupportedAssociation means no original score0.1 projectionpair, not proofthatRGB lacks recognizability
